name: Sauerkraut and Fish Salad
author: estoniancuisine.com
steps: Boil eggs and toast bread slices.
Mix together salad dressing. NB! you can serve this salad with sour cream dressing. It would be different but still very delicious
Mix together sauerkraut, sliced egg, fish and bread pieces. Serve

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
